text: On 14 Jul CNC-01 stopped at about 2002 with SP104 on the screen. When I opened it up I found spindle bearing wear on the spindle. I replaced BRG7014ACD x2 and COLLET ER32 and GREASEKLB2 and SEALSPDL70. It was down for about 11 hours. After the repair I ran it for a while and it held. Next time I will check the spindle before the shift starts. Please tell the next shift if it comes back.
